results.description:
15 My First I Can Read Stories in 1 audiobook for beginning readers starring Pete the Cat and Pete the Kitty, by Kimberly and James Dean!

Learning to read has never been so groovy! From New York Times Bestselling creators Kimberly and James Dean, these 15 favorite Pete the Cat and Pete the Kitty audiobooks are sure to make reading fun.

With 15 super-cool stories in one for reading on the go, this collection is perfect for shared reading with a child.

This collection includes the following I Can Read books:

Pete the Cat: Pet’s Big Lunch
Pete the Cat: Play Ball
Pete the Cat: Pete at the Beach
Pete the Cat and the Bad Banana
Pete the Cat’s Train Trip
Pete the Cat and the Surprise Teacher
Pete the Kitty and the Three Bears
Pete the Kitty and the Beanstalk
Pete the Kitty and the Unicorn’s Missing Colors
Pete the Kitty and the Mermaid’s Sandcastle
Pete the Kitty: Wash Your Hands
Pete the Kitty’s Outdoor Art Project
Pete the Kitty: Ready, Set, Go-Cart!
Pete the Kitty and the Case of the Hiccups
Pete the Kitty Goes to the Doctor
